name: Phentolamine
description: Alpha-adrenergic blocker that widens blood vessels; given by injection or as eye drops

status.humanEvidence: FDA approved (other uses); small ED trials

note.text: No FDA-approved phentolamine lists ED. Oral Vasomax and compounded Bimix and Trimix are not FDA approved.

bullets: **Blocks alpha-adrenergic receptors,** so blood vessels widen
**Penile arteries** appear mainly under alpha-adrenergic control
Alpha blockade helped erections in **animal and human lab models**
Oral ED Phase 3 trials known mainly via reviews
Injected ED data: small studies of mixes

practical.halfLife: 19 minutes in blood after a vein injection (label)
practical.routes: Injection, dental injection, eye drops; by mouth in ED trials
practical.pharmacokinetics: About 13% of a vein dose in urine unchanged
practical.soldAs: Prescription injection, OraVerse, Ryzumvi; Bimix and Trimix compounded
practical.monitored: Blood pressure, heart rate and rhythm

regulatory.text: Not approved for ED; Bimix, Trimix compounded

references: Hikma, phentolamine mesylate for injection label (DailyMed), Mar 2024
Goldstein et al., World J Urol, oral phentolamine review, Feb 2001
Bechara et al., J Urol, papaverine-phentolamine vs alprostadil, Jun 1997
